mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the replacement cam was most worthwhile: it made the connection between the cam's shape and the dragon's greeting visible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The straightforward mounting step was the least engaging; it advanced the build but revealed little on its own.

surprise.text: The old drawing of a fair in the air introduced an intriguing possibility beyond the dragon.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed a clear construction goal.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how Jo's old fair drawing connects to the toys and the dragon.
